title: Closing a half-filled form with the cross or Escape throws away everything typed, with no question
what: Add member, Sell membership and Collect payment close at once on the cross in the corner or the Escape key, the same as Cancel. Everything typed (name, mobile, birthday, address, emergency contact, price, amount, notes) is gone, and the next open starts empty. On a phone the cross sits at the top right where a thumb can hit it by mistake while scrolling a long form.
expected: When something has been typed, closing asks 'Throw away what you typed?' or keeps the typing for the next open.
how_often: whenever a filled form is closed by mistake
fix_line: Ask before closing a form that has typing in it

title: On a phone, '+ New batch' can sit hidden off the right edge of the batch row
what: On Add member the batch choices are one row that scrolls sideways on a phone, with the scroll bar hidden. The gym's batches come first and 'None' and '+ New batch' come last, so a gym with three or four batches has '+ New batch' off the screen and nothing shows the row can be swiped. A first-time desk person does not find how to add a new batch. The pass company row ends with '+ Other company' in the same way.
expected: '+ New batch' is always in view (first, or the row wraps), or the row shows it continues past the edge.
who: owners and front desk on a phone
how_often: every member added in a gym with several batches
fix_line: Let the batch and pass chip rows wrap, or put the add-new chip first

title: On Add member, the 'already has this number' and 'could not save' messages appear at the top, out of sight
what: Add member is a long form with the button at the bottom. When the number belongs to an archived member, or the save fails, the red message (with its Bring them back and Open their page buttons) appears at the very top of the form. The form is not scrolled up and the keyboard focus stays on the button, so on a phone the desk sees nothing happen after pressing Add member. Only a screen reader hears it.
expected: The message is brought into view (and focused) like the wrong-box messages are, so the desk sees it and its buttons at once.
who: owners and front desk on a phone
how_often: each clashing number or failed save on Add member
fix_line: Scroll the form to the top message and move the focus to it when it appears

title: A screen reader does not read the explanation under 'Comes with a pass' or 'Can train at every branch'
what: The tick boxes on the member form have a grey line under them saying what the tick means: for a pass, no plan, no dues and never on the renewal list. That line is not tied to the tick box, so a screen reader reads only the tick box's name and skips what it does to the member's money.
expected: The screen reader reads the explanation together with the tick box.
who: owners and desk staff using a screen reader
how_often: every time these boxes are reached
fix_line: Link the shared tick box's hint to the box so it is read out

title: 'Cancel receipt' stays greyed out with no word saying a reason of 3 letters is needed
what: On Cancel this receipt, the red button is greyed until 3 letters are typed in Reason. Nothing says so: the hint only says the reason is saved with the receipt. The message 'Write a short reason' can never show, because the greyed button cannot be pressed. An owner who opens the sheet sees a dead button.
expected: The hint says a short reason is needed to cancel, or the button stays pressable and shows the message.
fix_line: Say in the hint that a reason is needed before the receipt can be cancelled

title: On Collect payment, a wrong amount or date is shown only in a banner, not at the box
what: When the amount or the date received is wrong, Collect payment shows the reason in a red banner at the top. The wrong box itself is not marked red and not marked wrong for a screen reader, unlike the sell sheet and the member form, so the desk has to work out which box the banner means.
expected: The wrong box turns red with its message under it, as on the other forms.
how_often: each wrong amount or date on Collect payment
fix_line: Show the amount and date messages on their own boxes

items.reason: Sheets trap and return keyboard focus, close on Escape, buttons/chips/ticks are 44px, error banners are read out, muted and warning text pass contrast in both looks, colour always comes with words. Largest system font not checkable without a phone; axe crawl (dark only) reports 0 serious.
No screenshot of these sheets exists in docs; judged from code. Photo 'Remove' uses the plain text-look button already reported.
Camera closes back to the form with typing kept; photo-not-saved message says how to try again; but closing a filled form loses all typing.
